headword: {優柔不断|ゆうじゅうふだん}

definitions.explanation: Unable to make decisions promptly or firmly. Describes a person who hesitates and wavers when choices need to be made.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{優柔不断|ゆうじゅうふだん}だ。

⟦メニュー→メニュー：11166_menyuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}める→決める：00858_kimeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{三十分|さんじゅっぷん}→三十分：09672_sanjuppun⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧⟦なんて→なんて：06918_nante⟧、{優柔不断|ゆうじゅうふだん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{程|ほど}→程：01724_hodo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Taking thirty minutes to decide on the menu is being indecisive to an extreme.

examples.japanese: {優柔不断|ゆうじゅうふだん}な⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{直|なお}したくて、{即断即決|そくだんそっけつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{心|こころ}がけている→心がける：10015_kokorogakeru⟧。
examples.english: I want to fix my indecisive personality, so I try to make quick decisions.

notes:
USAGE:
A four-character compound (⟦{四字熟語|よじじゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧) commonly used in everyday conversation, not just formal writing. Almost always negative in nuance.

ETYMOLOGY:
{優柔|ゆうじゅう} (soft, gentle) + ⟦{不断|ふだん}→不断：24549_fudan⟧ (without cutting/deciding). Literally "soft and unable to cut" — unable to make a clean decision.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {優柔不断|ゆうじゅうふだん}な⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧ (indecisive personality)
- {優柔不断|ゆうじゅうふだん}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (an indecisive person)
